cases.title: Session ephemeral
cases.steps: On A1158 applied $60 (pending Applied row in CRM), then did a full reload of the invoice; then a second load. Also tried Ctrl+Shift+R.
cases.expected: Applied cleared; payable restored; no used row; wallet unchanged.
cases.actual: First full reload showed the widget reset but totals still -$60 / $940 (CRM row already removed); second load cleared to $1,000. Wallet unchanged. Ctrl+Shift+R did not reload the SPA.

cases.title: X clears and restores Applicable
cases.steps: Applied 30 on A1158, clicked X, re-applied.
cases.expected: Payable original; "up to" back to M; re-apply works; no used.
cases.actual: X restores payable $1,000 and "up to $100"; re-apply works; no used row. But the "You have $X" line shows $617.02 (30 subtracted) until the next apply. Same seen on A1158 ($537.02) and B1461 (KES 57,633).

cases.title: Below-max succeeds; remaining copy drops
cases.steps: Max 100; applied 60.
cases.expected: Accepted; "up to" = 100 - 60 = 40.
cases.actual: Apply 60 accepted (no limit error) but "up to" shows $34 (10% of 940 - 60) instead of 40.

cases.title: Portal payable = Stripe
cases.steps: Applied rewards and opened Stripe on several orders.
cases.expected: Stripe equals portal payable; CRM matches after pay.
cases.actual: Stripe sandbox amounts matched portal payable: $950, $905, $360, KES 869,080.

cases.title: Commit only on success; no double deduct
cases.steps: Successful Stripe pay with 45 applied on A1158; reloads afterwards.
cases.expected: Wallet -once; one used row; Rewards Used row; totals sticky; no second deduction.
cases.actual: Successful pay deducted once, one used row per redemption, totals sticky, no double deduction on reloads. But the commit happens when checkout opens, not on success (bug 1).

cases.title: Failed / abandoned payment
cases.steps: On A1158 applied $50, opened Stripe, pressed Back without paying; checked CRM row, contact and portal history; reloaded.
cases.expected: Wallet unchanged; no used row; pending cleared on hard return/refresh.
cases.actual: CRM row "Redeemed rewards against A1158" went Applied -> Used. Current 647.02 -> 597.02, Used 494.13 -> 544.13. Portal history shows the redemption; reload does not release it.

cases.title: Soft Back re-apply
cases.steps: After soft Back from Stripe (50 applied), tried to replace with 80.
cases.expected: Replacement validation = headroom + pending (up to 100); single pending row.
cases.actual: Soft Back keeps the $50, but it is already Used. Replacing with 80 blocked: "Rewards amount cannot exceed $45.00." Should allow replacement up to 100, and remaining should be 50, not 45.

cases.title: CRM Admin Rewards Redeemed (SO + BAS)
cases.steps: On A1159 (KES) created Rewards Redeemed from the order subpanel; tried > Applicable; saved 14,000; checked order, contact, portal; customer then opened Stripe and paid.
cases.expected: Prefill Current + Applicable; Applicable = order max; save <= Applicable updates order + wallet; > Applicable blocked; subpanel in order currency; persists.
cases.actual: PASS: prefill (name "Redeemed rewards by Maria.tariq against A1159", Current, Applicable, Total Shipping Cost read-only); Applicable = order max in order currency (KES 71,683, not USD 512.02); > Applicable/wallet blocked "Redeemed rewards cannot exceed the contact's current rewards."; subpanel Ksh14,000; order Savo Rewards -14,000 and portal shows it. FAIL: row status stays Applied; contact wallet NOT deducted on save; Current dropped $100 only when the customer opened Stripe; Used never increased; status still Applied after full payment.

cases.title: Total Shipping Cost on create
cases.steps: Opened Rewards Redeemed Create on A1158 (before/after bump), A1159, B1461.
cases.expected: Read-only, from order shipping; not Grand Total.
cases.actual: Read-only and equal to order shipping (1,000 / 1,400 / 840,000 / 7,644), not Grand Total.

cases.title: Wallet integrity
cases.steps: Compared contact Current vs Total - Used at start and end.
cases.expected: Current = Lifetime - Used; no random jumps.
cases.actual: No random jumps, but Current != Lifetime - Used: pre-existing 20.50 gap, grew to 120.50 after the admin redemption flow. Final: Current 412.02, Total 1,161.65, Used 629.13.

cases.title: Portal success visible in CRM
cases.steps: After portal Stripe pay with rewards, compared CRM and portal.
cases.expected: CRM field/subpanel/totals match; Rewards Used row.
cases.actual: CRM totals and subpanel match portal; history shows the redemption.

cases.title: Apply -> Remove -> Apply does not inflate
cases.steps: apply / X / apply / X / apply 30 on A1158.
cases.expected: Single pending row, not stacked.
cases.actual: Single Applied row $30 in CRM.

cases.title: Recording timing
cases.steps: Watched CRM row status before Stripe, at Stripe open, after pay.
cases.expected: Before pay: at most Applied; after pay: Used.
cases.actual: Row flips Applied -> Used and wallet drops at Stripe open, before payment.

cases.title: Wallet in order currency
cases.steps: Checked wallet display on KES order A1159.
cases.expected: KES-converted wallet; Applicable consistent.
cases.actual: Wallet shown as KES 71,683 (512.02 x 140) consistently on portal and CRM.

cases.title: Discount-parity smoke
cases.steps: Left page with portal rewards applied; checked admin reward; typed an invalid discount code.
cases.expected: Leaving clears session rewards; admin reward persists.
cases.actual: Leaving the page clears portal rewards; admin reward persists. Discount code field: invalid code gives no feedback and temporarily changes "up to" ($45 -> $95).

cases.title: Soft Back keeps; hard reload / leave clears
cases.steps: 1) Soft Back from Stripe to same invoice. 2) Hard reload. 3) Orders list -> /rewards -> back to invoice.
cases.expected: 1) pending kept (not committed); 2) reload clears; 3) navigation clears.
cases.actual: Step 1 FAIL: amount kept but already committed (Used). Step 2 FAIL: reload does not clear the committed amount (still $950). Step 3 PASS: navigating away and back clears pending and deletes the CRM row.

cases.title: Pay with session 0 after leftover pending
cases.expected: No wallet burn; no bulk applied -> used.
cases.actual: An orphan pending row could not be created via the UI.

cases.title: M-Pesa finalize without AccountReference
cases.actual: M-Pesa out of scope per instruction.

cases.title: Admin "by" survives portal replace-0; portal "against" cleared
cases.steps: On A1159 with admin "by" row (14,000), applied 5,768 on portal (twice), reloaded, navigated away.
cases.expected: Portal pending row created then cleared; admin row survives.
cases.actual: Portal apply 5,768 showed success but created no "against" row and no X; reload reverted. Admin "by" row survived leave/reload (that part PASS).

cases.title: Baseline wallet snapshot
cases.steps: Opened contact Sidney Test in CRM and recorded Current / Total (lifetime) / Used; opened portal Savo Rewards page and dashboard.
cases.expected: Portal rewards match CRM (currency-aware); W0, L0, U0 recorded.
cases.actual: Current $597.02, Total (lifetime) $1,111.65, Used $494.13. Portal $597.02 = CRM Current. Note: Total - Used = 617.52, i.e. Current is 20.50 lower than the formula already at baseline.

cases.title: Complete an order to earn rewards
cases.steps: Created new Shipping Only order A1157 on portal: 50 chargeable kg x $20 = $1,000 shipping. Paid $1,000 via Stripe sandbox (card 4242) without rewards. Moved order to Order Delivered in CRM. Checked Loyalty/Rewards on contact and portal.
cases.expected: New earned row; L1 > L0; W1 = L1 - U0; portal matches CRM.
cases.actual: Loyalty row $50 (5% of $1,000). Current 597.02 -> 647.02 (+50), Total 1,111.65 -> 1,161.65 (+50); portal matched. However W1 = L1 - U0 is false: 647.02 vs 667.52 because of the pre-existing 20.50 gap (see bug 4).

cases.title: Seed wallet for multi-redeem
cases.steps: Checked wallet after E1.
cases.expected: Current Rewards >= $100.

cases.title: Initial redeem (SO Ship Individually)
cases.steps: On A1158 ($1,000 shipping, 1 package; an earlier $50 had already been committed - see #165177 B6): checked portal cap and CRM Rewards Redeemed Create Applicable; applied 45 on portal; opened Stripe ($905) and paid in sandbox; checked CRM order totals, contact, Rewards Redeemed row and portal history.
cases.expected: Portal Applicable = 10% of shipping; CRM Applicable = portal; wallet reduced by redeemed; balance >= 0; one used row in order currency; portal Rewards Used row only after success.
cases.actual: Portal cap = 10% of shipping; CRM Create Applicable 45.00 = portal "up to $45" (after the earlier $50). Applied 45, Stripe $905, paid. CRM: Savo Rewards -95, Paid 905, Balance 0; Used rows in order currency; portal history rows present. Contact after pay: Current 552.02, Used 589.13. Note: the Rewards Used row / Used status appears when checkout opens, not only after success (bug 1).
cases.verdict_text: PASS (run in USD on A1158 instead of KES 10,000)

cases.title: Shipping increase unlocks additional rewards (anti-overpay)
cases.steps: Added 2nd package $400 to A1158 in CRM (shipping 1,000 -> 1,400; already paid-through 1,000). Checked portal "up to".
cases.expected: Applicable = 10% of new unpaid shipping only; no customer credit.
cases.actual: Portal Applicable $40 = 10% of unpaid $400 - not 45 (140 - 95) and not 140.
cases.correction: User confirmed: the limit after adding a parcel uses only the new unpaid shipping; intended.

cases.title: Second payment redeems additional
cases.steps: Applied 40 on A1158, paid Stripe sandbox $360.
cases.expected: Additional used activity in CRM; Rewards Used lists multiple redemptions.
cases.actual: Paid. Three separate Used rows $50 / $45 / $40 in CRM and in portal history. CRM final: balance 0; contact Current 512.02, Used 629.13.

cases.title: Block over-cap (seeded)
cases.steps: With remaining cap 40, applied 41.
cases.expected: Rejected with limit message; no pending; wallet unchanged; copy still C.
cases.actual: "Rewards amount cannot exceed $40.00."; no pending row; wallet unchanged; copy still 40.

cases.title: Cap ignores non-shipping (incl. Misc)
cases.steps: On A1159 (KES): shipping 840,000 + protection 280 + next-day door delivery 42,000 + misc 800. Checked portal and CRM Applicable.
cases.expected: Applicable = 10% of shipping only; CRM = portal.
cases.actual: Cap based on shipping only (10% = 84,000), limited by wallet to KES 71,683 on both portal and CRM.

cases.title: Insufficient wallet (seeded)
cases.steps: On A1159 applied 84,000 (the shipping cap) and 71,684 (wallet + 1).
cases.expected: Rejected; wallet unchanged; no pending.
cases.actual: Both blocked with "Rewards amount cannot exceed KES 71,683.00."; no pending; wallet unchanged. Minor: wording does not mention insufficient wallet.

cases.title: CRM vs Portal parity
cases.steps: After shipping bump on A1158, opened CRM Rewards Redeemed Create.
cases.expected: CRM Applicable == portal == min(wallet, 10% x unpaid).
cases.actual: CRM Create Applicable 40.00 = portal $40; Total Shipping Cost read-only 1,400.

cases.title: Buy & Ship parity
cases.steps: Created B&S order B1461 (KES) on portal: shipping KES 7,644, grand total 23,179. Checked portal "up to", CRM Applicable, applied 50 then X, tried exact max, looked for card payment.
cases.expected: Same unpaid-shipping rule as SO; apply/pay/commit works on BAS.
cases.actual: Portal "up to" KES 764.40 = 10% of shipping only - PASS. CRM Applicable 764.40 - PASS. Apply 50 then X restores - PASS. Exact 764.40 (and 764.39) would not apply, only 764 - FAIL (minor). B&S invoice offers only "Pay By M- Pesa", no card; Stripe route redirects to list -> payment and commit not tested - BLOCKED (M-Pesa out of scope). Order-total label did not update after apply. B1461 left with a portal-only pending 764 not in CRM.

cases.title: Partial first redeem then shipping increase
cases.steps: Same run as A2 (USD numbers).
cases.expected: Additional Applicable from new unpaid shipping only.
cases.actual: $40 = 10% of the new unpaid $400.
cases.correction: User confirmed: the limit after adding a parcel uses only the new unpaid shipping; intended.

cases.title: Balance never negative
cases.steps: Checked balances after every redeem+pay (A1158, A1159).
cases.expected: total_balance >= 0; paid + rewards = total.
cases.actual: Balances 0, never negative; paid + rewards = total.

cases.title: No double wallet deduction
cases.steps: Tracked wallet across payments and reloads.
cases.expected: Wallet decreased once per successful redemption.
cases.actual: Each successful redemption deducted once; reloads caused no extra deduction.

cases.title: Full Ship Individually story
cases.steps: Package 1 $1,000 then package 2 $400 on A1158; redeemed and paid for each.
cases.expected: End-to-end CRM + portal + Rewards Used correct; W = L - U.
cases.actual: Flow works end-to-end; final W = L - U equality fails (gap 20.50 at that point).

cases.title: Wallet never negative; no duplicate used on retry
cases.steps: Webhook retry is not possible from the UI; repeated reloads of success/invoice pages.
cases.expected: No negative wallet; no duplicate used rows; W = L - U.
cases.actual: Repeated reloads produced no duplicate used rows; wallet never negative. Webhook retry itself not exercised.

cases.title: Copy drops after partial apply on shipping increment; X restores
cases.steps: After shipping bump (cap 40), applied 15, read "up to"; then clicked X.
cases.expected: After apply copy = 40 - 15 = 25; after X copy = 40, pending gone, prior used unchanged.
cases.actual: After apply: "up to $23.50" (expected 25; appears computed as 10% of 385 - 15). X restores 40, pending removed, prior used unchanged. Wallet banner briefly showed $537.02 after X (bug 7).
